description: Fixture-backed personal task list and reminders: list, get, create, complete, and snooze.

capability_notes.summary: All actions operate on one fixture-backed personal list; there is no multi-project hierarchy or live sync.
Creating a task appends an open record with a deterministic task id and narrative created_at.
Completing an open task sets status to completed and records completed_at; already-completed tasks return 409.
Snooze updates due_at on an open task to the provided until timestamp without removing the task.
